Therefore the nilradical N has locally free rank one. Locally N=A epsilon; as N ideal, epsilon^2=c epsilon; nilpotence implies c^(m-1)=0, reduced A forces c=0, so N^2=0. Multiplication gives B->End_A(N)≅A (canonical for invertible rank-one N), splitting A->B; N annihilates itself so this factors E->A, a section of finite étale E/A. Hence E≅A×C, with C étale rank s-1. Unique idempotent lift through square-zero N splits B and yields B≅(A⊕N)×C with square-zero multiplication and unique gluing. Thus X≅Spec_Y(O⊕L) disjoint union Z; connected X_red with s>1 impossible.
